_comment: unpaired-v3: unpaired-v2 with the harmonic dimension weighted zero. Its three
terms are measured on the longest steady note the pitch tracker finds. Across
two performances it could not tell the settings apart: with one passage at
one setting as the target and another passage at every setting as the
candidates, the right setting scored closest 14.9% and 13.5% of the time on
SW50R and Tone King, chance 14.3%, where timbre managed 26.5% and 22.7%
from unpaired-v3' in docs/tone-matching-plan.md). paired-v2 is unchanged:
whether the dimension helps a match against a real reamp was not measured.
Its own file, as the -v2 ones: earlier files stay byte-identical.

unpaired-v3.description: A commercial recording against a render. As unpaired-v2, without the harmonic dimension: between two performances it did no better than chance at picking the setting.
